```{ojs}
viewof filters = {
  clearFilters;   // re-run (and so reset) this form whenever "Clear filters" is clicked

  const unique = col => [...new Set(data.map(d => d[col]).filter(v => v != null && v !== ""))].sort();
  const inputs = {};

  inputs.q = Inputs.text({label: "Search", placeholder: "Any column…"});

  const projIds = [...new Set(data.flatMap(d => d.projects))].sort();
  if (projIds.length) inputs.projects = Inputs.select(projIds, {
    label: "Project", multiple: true, format: id => projectName.get(id) ?? id
  });

  const sites = unique("site");
  if (sites.length > 1) inputs.site = Inputs.select(sites, {label: "Site", multiple: true});

  inputs.from = Inputs.date({label: "From"});
  inputs.to   = Inputs.date({label: "To"});

  for (const c of filterCols) {
    const label = c.label + (c.units ? ` (${c.units})` : "");
    if (c.filter === "multiselect") {
      const opts = c.values.length ? c.values : unique(c.column);
      inputs[c.column] = opts.length <= 8
        ? Inputs.checkbox(opts, {label})
        : Inputs.select(opts, {label, multiple: true});
    } else if (c.filter === "select" || c.filter === "checkbox") {
      inputs[c.column] = Inputs.select([null, ...unique(c.column)], {label, format: v => v ?? "(any)"});
    } else if (c.filter === "search") {
      inputs[c.column] = Inputs.text({label, placeholder: "contains…"});
    } else if (c.filter === "range") {
      const v = data.map(d => d[c.column]).filter(x => x != null);
      inputs[c.column] = Inputs.form([
        Inputs.number({label: `${label} ≥`, placeholder: d3.min(v)}),
        Inputs.number({label: `${label} ≤`, placeholder: d3.max(v)})
      ]);
    }
  }
  return Inputs.form(inputs);
}
```

```{ojs}
mapView = {
  const el = html`<div style="height:460px;border-radius:6px;"></div>`;
  const map = leaflet.map(el, {preferCanvas: true, scrollWheelZoom: false, minZoom: 3});
  leaflet.tileLayer("https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
    maxZoom: 18, attribution: "&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors"
  }).addTo(map);
  const layer = leaflet.layerGroup().addTo(map);

  const wrap = html`<div>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">
    ${el}
  </div>`;
  wrap.map = map;
  wrap.layer = layer;

  // Remember the area to show; apply it only once the map has a real size
  wrap.fit = bounds => {
    wrap.target = bounds;
    if (el.clientWidth && el.clientHeight) map.fitBounds(bounds, {maxZoom: 13});
  };
  new ResizeObserver(() => {
    if (!el.clientWidth || !el.clientHeight) return;
    map.invalidateSize();
    if (wrap.target) map.fitBounds(wrap.target, {maxZoom: 13});
  }).observe(el);

  wrap.fit(CANADA);
  return wrap;
}
```

```{ojs}
// One marker per location; redrawn when the filters or the row selection change
{
  const {map, layer} = mapView;
  layer.clearLayers();
  const sel = new Set(selection.map(d => d.uid));
  const pts = filtered.filter(d => d.lat != null && d.lon != null);

  // Same plot = same marker. Rows without a plot are grouped by their coordinates.
  const groups = d3.groups(pts, d => d.plot || `${d.lat.toFixed(5)},${d.lon.toFixed(5)}`);

  for (const [key, rows] of groups) {
    rows.sort((a, b) => (a.date_start ?? 0) - (b.date_start ?? 0));   // oldest visit first
    const n = rows.length;
    const anySel = rows.some(d => sel.has(d.uid));
    leaflet.circleMarker([rows[0].lat, rows[0].lon], {
      radius: (anySel ? 8 : 6) + Math.min(n - 1, 4),   // slightly bigger for repeat visits
      weight: n > 1 ? 2 : 1,
      color: "#fff",
      fillColor: anySel ? "#d95f02" : "#1b6f7a",
      fillOpacity: 0.85
    })
      .bindTooltip(n > 1 ? `${key} · ${n} visits` : key)
      .bindPopup(groupPopup(rows, sel), {maxHeight: 260})
      .addTo(layer);
  }

   const inArea = pts.filter(d => CANADA.contains([d.lat, d.lon]));
  mapView.fit(inArea.length
    ? leaflet.latLngBounds(inArea.map(d => [d.lat, d.lon])).pad(0.2)
    : CANADA);

  const missing = filtered.length - pts.length;
  return html`<small>${pts.length} of ${filtered.length} datapoints at ${groups.length} location(s)${
    missing ? ` (${missing} without coordinates)` : ""}.</small>`;
}
```

## Get the data

```{ojs}
viewof params = {
  const inputs = {};
  for (const [key, s] of Object.entries(meta.params ?? {})) {
    const label = s.label ?? key;
    inputs[key] =
      s.type === "select"   ? Inputs.select(asArray(s.options), {label, value: s.default}) :
      s.type === "number"   ? Inputs.number({label, value: s.default}) :
      s.type === "checkbox" ? Inputs.toggle({label, value: !!s.default}) :
                              Inputs.text({label, value: s.default ?? ""});
  }
  return Inputs.form(inputs);
}
```

```{ojs}
  const shortened = codePreview !== code;
  return html`<div>
    ${copy} ${download}
    <small>${codeRows.length.toLocaleString()} datapoint(s), ${selection.length ? "ticked rows" : "all filtered rows"}${
      shortened ? `. Preview shortened to ${PREVIEW_ROWS}; Copy and Download include all of them.` : ""}</small>
    <pre class="sourceCode" style="margin-top:.5rem"><code>${codePreview}</code></pre>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// ---- Data written by build.R ---------------------------------------------
meta     = FileAttachment("../_generated/datatypes/{{id}}.json").json()
raw      = FileAttachment("../_generated/datatypes/{{id}}.csv").csv()
links    = FileAttachment("../_generated/project_links.csv").csv()
overview = FileAttachment("../_generated/projects_overview.csv").csv()

// ---- Helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------
// jsonlite writes empty R lists as {} rather than [] or null, so normalise them
asArray    = v => Array.isArray(v) ? v : (v == null || typeof v === "object" ? [] : [v])
str        = v => typeof v === "string" ? v : ""
num        = v => (v === "" || v == null) ? null : +v
isDate     = v => v instanceof Date && !isNaN(v)
escapeHtml = s => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g,
  c => ({"&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;"}[c]))

// ---- Columns ----------------------------------------------------------------
cols = asArray(meta.columns).map(c => ({
  ...c, values: asArray(c.values), units: str(c.units), label: str(c.label) || c.column
}))
publicCols = cols.filter(c => c.visibility === "public")
filterCols = publicCols.filter(c => c.filter && c.filter !== "none")

sharedLabels = ({
  datapoint_name: meta.shared_labels?.datapoint_name ?? "Name",
  plot: "Plot", site: "Site", date: "Date", lat: "Latitude", lon: "Longitude", projects: "Projects"
})
labelOf = col => sharedLabels[col] ?? cols.find(c => c.column === col)?.label ?? col

tableCols = {
  const shown = asArray(meta.display?.table);
  const cs = shown.length ? [...shown]
    : ["datapoint_name", "plot", "site", "date", ...publicCols.map(c => c.column)];
  if (!cs.includes("projects")) cs.push("projects");
  return cs;
}

// ---- Rows ---------------------------------------------------------------------
projectName   = new Map(overview.map(p => [p.id, p.name]))
projectsByUid = d3.rollup(links.filter(l => l.datatype === meta.id),
                          v => v.map(l => l.project_id), l => l.uid)

data = raw.map(r => {
  const d = {
    ...r,
    lat: num(r.lat), lon: num(r.lon),
    date_start: r.date_start ? new Date(r.date_start) : null,
    date_end:   r.date_end   ? new Date(r.date_end)   : null,
    projects:   projectsByUid.get(r.uid) ?? []
  };
  for (const c of cols) if (c.type === "number") d[c.column] = num(r[c.column]);
  d._text = ["datapoint_name", "plot", "site", "date", ...publicCols.map(c => c.column)]
    .map(k => r[k] ?? "").join(" ").toLowerCase();
  return d;
})

filtered = data.filter(d => {
  const f = filters;
  if (f.q && !d._text.includes(f.q.toLowerCase())) return false;
  if (f.projects?.length && !f.projects.some(p => d.projects.includes(p))) return false;
  if (f.site?.length && !f.site.includes(d.site)) return false;
  // keep rows whose date range overlaps the chosen range (works for "2022" too)
  if (isDate(f.from) && (!d.date_end   || d.date_end   < f.from)) return false;
  if (isDate(f.to)   && (!d.date_start || d.date_start > f.to))   return false;

  for (const c of filterCols) {
    const v = d[c.column], fv = f[c.column];
    switch (c.filter) {
      case "multiselect":
        if (fv.length && !fv.includes(v)) return false; break;
      case "select": case "checkbox":
        if (fv != null && v !== fv) return false; break;
      case "search":
        if (fv && !String(v ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(fv.toLowerCase())) return false; break;
      case "range": {
        const [lo, hi] = fv;
        if (Number.isFinite(lo) && !(v >= lo)) return false;
        if (Number.isFinite(hi) && !(v <= hi)) return false;
      }
    }
  }
  return true;
})

codeRows = selection.length ? selection : filtered

// ---- Map ----------------------------------------------------------------------
leaflet = require("leaflet@1.9.4")

CANADA = leaflet.latLngBounds([41, -141], [70, -52])

popupHtml = d => {
  const tpl = str(meta.display?.popup);
  if (!tpl) return escapeHtml(d.datapoint_name);
  return tpl.replace(/\{\{\s*([^}]+?)\s*\}\}/g, (_, k) => escapeHtml(d[k]));
}

// Popup for one location: plot heading, then one line per visit
groupPopup = (rows, sel) => {
  const first = rows[0];
  const title = escapeHtml(first.plot || first.datapoint_name);
  const site  = first.site ? ` <small>(${escapeHtml(first.site)})</small>` : "";
  const items = rows.map(d =>
    `<li>${popupHtml(d)}${sel.has(d.uid) ? " <b>✓</b>" : ""}</li>`).join("");
  return `<b>${title}</b>${site}<br>
          <small>${rows.length} datapoint${rows.length > 1 ? "s" : ""}</small>
          <ul style="padding-left:1.1em;margin:.3em 0 0">${items}</ul>`;
}

// ---- Code templates -------------------------------------------------------------
Mustache = {
  const mod = await require("mustache@4.2.0");
  const m = mod.default ?? mod;
  m.escape = s => String(s);   // we are generating code, not HTML: never escape
  return m;
}

templates = asArray(meta.templates).filter(t => typeof t.text === "string" && t.text.trim() !== "")

PREVIEW_ROWS = 5

currentTemplate = templates.find(t => t.label === templateLabel) ?? templates[0]

renderCode = rows => {
  if (!currentTemplate || !rows.length) return "";
  const rs = rows.map((r, i, a) => ({...r, first: i === 0, last: i === a.length - 1}));
  return Mustache.render(currentTemplate.text,
    {datatype_id: meta.id, n_rows: codeRows.length, ...params, rows: rs}).trim();
}

// Full script: what Copy and Download use
code = renderCode(codeRows)

// Shortened script for the page: first few rows plus a "… N more" line
codePreview = codeRows.length <= PREVIEW_ROWS + 1
  ? code
  : renderCode([
      ...codeRows.slice(0, PREVIEW_ROWS),
      {datapoint_name: `… ${(codeRows.length - PREVIEW_ROWS).toLocaleString()} more (included when you copy or download)`}
    ])
```
